meaning.en: Gautama said

meaning.en: O Lord
meaning.hi: हे भगवन्

meaning.en: knower of every duty
meaning.hi: हर कर्तव्य के ज्ञाता

meaning.en: master of every scripture
meaning.hi: समस्त शास्त्रों में निपुण

meaning.en: the awakening to the deepest knowledge of the self
meaning.hi: आत्मा के गहनतम ज्ञान का जागरण

meaning.en: indeed, by what means does it happen
meaning.hi: वास्तव में किस उपाय से होता है

meaning.en: Sanatkumara said
meaning.hi: सनत्कुमार ने कहा

meaning.en: having studied deeply through every Veda
meaning.hi: समस्त वेदों में गहराई से विचार करके

meaning.en: and knowing the teaching given by Shiva, the bow-bearer

meaning.en: the truth spoken to Parvati

meaning.en: listen, Gautama, to this from me

meaning.en: this cannot be fully put into words, it is a hidden secret
meaning.hi: यह पूरी तरह शब्दों में नहीं आ सकता, यह गुप्त है

meaning.en: kept like a treasure by those on the yogic path
meaning.hi: योगियों द्वारा कोष के समान सँभाला गया

meaning.en: it opens up the true, expansive form of Hamsa
meaning.hi: यह हंस के सच्चे, विस्तृत स्वरूप को खोलता है

meaning.en: granting the fruit of both worldly enjoyment and liberation
meaning.hi: भोग और मोक्ष दोनों का फल देने वाला

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: now we will explain the distinction between Hamsa and Paramahamsa
meaning.hi: अब हम हंस और परमहंस का भेद स्पष्ट करेंगे

meaning.en: for one who is celibate, calm, self-restrained, and devoted to the teacher
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मचारी, शांत, संयमी और गुरुभक्त के लिए

meaning.en: constantly meditating on 'Hamsa, Hamsa'
meaning.hi: निरंतर 'हंस, हंस' का ध्यान करते हुए

meaning.en: comes to pervade and dwell in every body
meaning.hi: सभी शरीरों में व्याप्त होकर स्थित रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: just as fire is present within wood
meaning.hi: जैसे अग्नि लकड़ी में मौजूद है

meaning.en: as oil is present within a sesame seed
meaning.hi: जैसे तेल तिल में मौजूद है

meaning.en: having come to know That directly
meaning.hi: उसे प्रत्यक्ष जानकर

meaning.en: one passes beyond the grip of death
meaning.hi: मृत्यु की पकड़ से परे चला जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: drawing in the base firmly, lifting the inner breath from its root
meaning.hi: मूल को दृढ़ता से खींचकर, वहाँ से श्वास को ऊपर उठाकर

meaning.en: circling it three times through the pelvic centre
meaning.hi: श्रोणि-केंद्र में उसे तीन बार घुमाकर

meaning.en: moving onward through the centre at the navel
meaning.hi: फिर नाभि-केंद्र से होते हुए आगे बढ़कर

meaning.en: passing beyond the centre at the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय-केंद्र को पार करके

meaning.en: arriving at the centre in the throat
meaning.hi: कंठ-केंद्र में पहुँचकर

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: holding the breath steady
meaning.hi: श्वास को स्थिर रोककर

meaning.en: keeping the mind fixed on the command-centre between the eyebrows
meaning.hi: आज्ञा-केंद्र पर मन को टिकाते हुए

meaning.en: letting attention settle on the subtle opening at the crown
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मरंध्र पर ध्यान स्थिर करते हुए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: I am the one measured out in three parts
meaning.hi: मैं तीन भागों में मापा गया हूँ

meaning.en: holding this thought steadily at all times
meaning.hi: इस विचार को सदा दृढ़ता से थामे हुए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then the sound current, flowing from the base to the crown
meaning.hi: फिर नाद, जो मूल से मस्तक-शीर्ष तक बहता है

meaning.en: radiant and clear like pure crystal
meaning.hi: शुद्ध स्फटिक के समान उज्ज्वल और स्वच्छ

words.sanskrit: sah vai brahma paramatma iti uchyate

meaning.en: this indeed is called Brahman and the Supreme Self
meaning.hi: यही ब्रह्म और परमात्मा कहा जाता है

meaning.en: its metre is the unmanifest form of Gayatri
meaning.hi: इसका छन्द अव्यक्त गायत्री है

meaning.en: Paramahamsa is its presiding deity
meaning.hi: परमहंस इसके अधिष्ठाता देवता हैं

meaning.en: the word 'That' is the living power
meaning.hi: 'सः' शब्द सजीव शक्ति है

meaning.en: 'I am That' is the locking element
meaning.hi: 'सोऽहम्' कीलक है

meaning.en: counted by this measure of six

meaning.en: across a day and a night
meaning.hi: एक दिन-रात में

meaning.en: twenty-one thousand
meaning.hi: इक्कीस हज़ार

meaning.en: plus an additional six hundred
meaning.hi: और अतिरिक्त छह सौ होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: addressed to the Sun and to the Moon
meaning.hi: सूर्य और चंद्र को संबोधित

meaning.en: spotless, beyond ordinary appearance
meaning.hi: निर्मल, सामान्य रूप-रंग से परे

meaning.en: may this subtle awareness be drawn out and awakened
meaning.hi: यह सूक्ष्म चेतना जागृत हो

meaning.en: through the joining of fire and moon-energy, this offering-sound is spoken
meaning.hi: अग्नि और चंद्र के मिलन से यह आहुति-ध्वनि कही जाती है

meaning.en: this leads into the sealing gestures on the heart and other limbs

meaning.en: having completed this

meaning.en: within the eight-petaled space of the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय के अष्टदल में

meaning.en: one should meditate on the Hamsa self
meaning.hi: हंस-आत्मा का ध्यान करना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: fire and moon-energy are its two wings
meaning.hi: अग्नि और चंद्र इसके दोनों पंख हैं

meaning.en: the syllable Om is its head
meaning.hi: ॐ इसका सिर है

meaning.en: the point of light is its eyes
meaning.hi: बिंदु इसकी आँखें हैं

meaning.en: its mouth is Rudra
meaning.hi: इसका मुख रुद्र है

meaning.en: Rudra's consort is its feet
meaning.hi: रुद्राणी इसके चरण हैं

words.sanskrit: bahu kalash cha agnish cha ubhe parshve bhavatah

meaning.en: time and fire are its arms, standing at its two sides
meaning.hi: काल और अग्नि इसकी भुजाएँ हैं, दोनों पार्श्व में स्थित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this same being is Paramahamsa
meaning.hi: यही सत्ता परमहंस है

meaning.en: blazing with the light of ten million suns
meaning.hi: करोड़ों सूर्यों के समान तेजोमय

meaning.en: by which all this is pervaded
meaning.hi: जिससे यह सब व्याप्त है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this same presence expresses itself in eight distinct ways
meaning.hi: यही उपस्थिति आठ प्रकार से व्यक्त होती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: so the mind itself is examined and understood as Hamsa
meaning.hi: अतः मन को ही हंस के रूप में परखा जाता है

meaning.en: it is this same mind that, through countless repetitions, directly experiences the sound
meaning.hi: वही मन अनगिनत जप से नाद का सीधा अनुभव करता है

words.sanskrit: evam sarvam hamsa-vashat nadah dashavidhah jayate

meaning.en: in this way, under Hamsa's influence, ten kinds of sound arise
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार हंस के प्रभाव से दस प्रकार का नाद उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: the first is a soft chime
meaning.hi: पहली एक कोमल टंकार है

meaning.en: the second is a doubled, closer chime
meaning.hi: दूसरी एक दोहरी, निकट टंकार है

meaning.en: the third is a temple-bell sound
meaning.hi: तीसरी घंटी की ध्वनि है

meaning.en: the fourth is a conch sound
meaning.hi: चौथी शंख की ध्वनि है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the fifth is a lute-string sound
meaning.hi: पाँचवीं वीणा-तार की ध्वनि है

meaning.en: the sixth is a cymbal sound
meaning.hi: छठी झाँझ की ध्वनि है

meaning.en: the seventh is a flute sound
meaning.hi: सातवीं बाँसुरी की ध्वनि है

meaning.en: the eighth is a drum sound
meaning.hi: आठवीं मृदंग की ध्वनि है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the ninth is a great war-drum sound
meaning.hi: नवीं युद्ध-नगाड़े की ध्वनि है

meaning.en: the tenth is a thunder-cloud sound
meaning.hi: दसवीं मेघ-गर्जन की ध्वनि है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: having set aside the ninth
meaning.hi: नवें को छोड़कर

meaning.en: one should practice and return only to the tenth
meaning.hi: केवल दसवें का ही अभ्यास करना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: at the first, a chiming sensation ripples through the body
meaning.hi: पहले में, शरीर में टंकार-जैसी सिहरन दौड़ती है

meaning.en: at the second, the body shifts and stirs
meaning.hi: दूसरे में, शरीर हिलता-डुलता है

meaning.en: at the third, a wave of tiredness passes through
meaning.hi: तीसरे में, थकान की लहर गुज़रती है

meaning.en: at the fourth, the head begins to tremble
meaning.hi: चौथे में, सिर काँपने लगता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: at the fifth, moisture flows at the roof of the mouth
meaning.hi: पाँचवें में, तालु से रस बहता है

meaning.en: at the sixth, that flow is savoured like nectar
meaning.hi: छठे में, उस रस का अमृत-सा स्वाद लिया जाता है

meaning.en: at the seventh, a hidden understanding dawns
meaning.hi: सातवें में, एक छिपी समझ उदय होती है

meaning.en: at the eighth, speech beyond the ordinary reveals itself
meaning.hi: आठवें में, सामान्य से परे वाणी प्रकट होती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: at the ninth, the body disappears from awareness
meaning.hi: नवें में, शरीर चेतना से विलुप्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: and a clear, luminous sight opens up
meaning.hi: और एक स्पष्ट, दीप्तिमान दृष्टि खुलती है

meaning.en: at the tenth, one comes to rest in the Supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: दसवें में, परम ब्रह्म में विश्राम मिलता है

meaning.en: standing in the closest nearness to one's own deepest self
meaning.hi: अपनी ही गहनतम आत्मा की समीपता में

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: at that point the mind itself dissolves
meaning.hi: उस बिंदु पर मन स्वयं विलीन हो जाता है

meaning.en: every plan and doubt burns away in the mind's dissolution
meaning.hi: मन के विलय में योजना और संदेह जल जाते हैं

meaning.en: and both good and bad deeds
meaning.hi: और अच्छे-बुरे कर्म भी

meaning.en: Sadashiva, the very soul of divine power, present everywhere
meaning.hi: सदाशिव, दिव्य शक्ति की साक्षात आत्मा, सर्वत्र उपस्थित

words.sanskrit: svayam-jyotih shuddhah buddhah nityah nirananjanah shantah prakashate iti

meaning.en: self-luminous, pure, fully awake, eternal, untouched, at peace, now shines forth
meaning.hi: स्वयं-प्रकाशमान, शुद्ध, जागृत, नित्य, अस्पृष्ट, शांत, अब प्रकट होता है
